content.text: {"r1_grounded":true,"r2_binding_constraint":true,"r3_buyer_enabling":false,"r4_owned_dated":true,"r5_honest_bounded":true,"r6_respects_process":true,"r7_beyond_hygiene":true,"r8_feasible":true,"best_practice_rule":"PB-03","critique":"Weakest is r3: the step is mostly seller-side (confirm invite, get email, set CRM field, pre-brief) and produces nothing Maya can forward to Priscilla; fix by adding a short CFO brief or approval-path checklist Maya can bring, with the business case due Oct 2, so the decision process question gets answered by the customer."}
